client_request_id_purpose: ASCII support trace only; not an idempotency key or retrieval handle.

request.prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG sheet, exact canvas 1440x672 and viewBox="0 0 1440 672". Three columns by two rows, six local scenes of 480x336 in row-major order. These are FUTURE SPIRE AFTERMATH MATERIAL ILLUSTRATIONS: settled environmental remnants, not current runtime cues, timed VFX, animation frames, card replacements or new rules. Use no people, living creatures, faces, eyes, names, inscriptions or stat symbols.

Six separate TOP-LEVEL <g id="SUBJECT-ID" transform="translate(X Y)"> groups as ordered below. Each begins with its own <rect x="0" y="0" width="480" height="336" fill="#172928"/>. No other root drawing or shared background. Keep every mark inside its group/cell, with at least 28px clear inset INCLUDING shadows. Extract each scene by removing only its grid translation. No labels, visible grid, gutters, border or card frame.

Native static paths/simple shapes and explicit colors only: no raster/image, scripts, external links, text/fonts, animation, CSS, defs, gradients, masks, filters or use references. About 35-60 purposeful vector shapes per scene; broad contour, structural overlaps and three value groups before sparse form-following cuts. Avoid tiny texture, glossy plastic, saturated glow and decorative symmetry.

Shared engraved fantasy direction: dark ink #172928/#2d403a, middle stone #63746d, pale fractured stone/silk #d6cfb6; muted copper #b97c5e, sage/olive poison #82937d/#789460, gel teal #659a9a, quiet plum #665361, restrained heat #b87952. Upper-left light. Differentiate brittle stone, viscous residue, thin translucent gel, fibrous silk, charred cloth and scorched rock. Gel may use a few simple opacity planes so its empty membrane stays distinct from opaque poison. One dominant asymmetric gesture and useful negative space per scene. Fill roughly 70-78% of the scene with stable settled forms; clear identity at 160x112 and 80x56, major contour also at 64x45. Do not make six identical puddles, badges, halos or explosive icons.

ROW-MAJOR SUBJECTS:
1. id="impact-scree" translate(0 0): A freshly broken stone step edge with three main unequal angular chunks, one deep diagonal compression crack, a large clear punched-out gap and a few small grounded chips. Pale fresh fracture against dark old stone. Settled impact residue, no airborne explosion.
2. id="poison-residue" translate(480 0): One viscous sage/olive chemical seep curling across a chipped dark stone tile. A broad leading tongue, one thick pooled lobe and two subordinate traces; distinguish the wet layer from exposed dry stone through edge thickness and restrained reflection. No vessel, skull or green aura.
3. id="split-slime-membrane" translate(960 0): Two EMPTY translucent blue-green gel husk flaps separated by a large central tear, with one continuous thick rolled rim and a thin wet inner plane. One flap leads diagonally; the answering flap droops low. Material remnants, no living slime, eyes, face or creature anatomy.
4. id="ruptured-web" translate(0 336): An asymmetric torn silk web sheet sagging between two unequal broken stone anchors. One large offset hole, three broad surviving strand bundles and a few irregular connected folds; silk stays pale and matte. No spider, radial emblem, regular lattice or many tiny threads.
5. id="ritual-cinder-sweep" translate(480 336): One bent plum/charcoal cloth remnant, charred along a curled edge, resting in a low asymmetric sweep of ash. One restrained copper ember under the fold and one large quiet opening. A proposed material aftermath of ritual power, not a rune, magical ring or established lore.
6. id="explosive-scorch" translate(960 336): A shallow blackened crater in a broad hard-stone fragment, three muted rust/orange heat seams and one tapering charcoal trail to the right. Scorched surface and recessed bowl dominate; at most two small settled chips. No fireball, active explosion, weapon or symmetrical burst.

Deliver six separable material studies. Prioritize physical interpretation, contour and broad planes. Review-only future concepts, not canon.

request_wire_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=false; no extra whitespace

billing.bound: Terra full published maxima: 922k input at $2/M + 128k output at $7.50/M = $2.804; plus unchanged $0.892 fixed-reference/prompt allowance = $3.696, rounded to $3.70. Planning reservation, not API dollar cap.

extraction.recipe: Copy each top-level group by filename stem; remove only its grid translate; keep local background and vector contents.

review.png: RGBA, no color profile; smaller of original/optimized encoding retained after exact decoded-pixel/dimension/alpha/mode/color-metadata equality.
review.verdict: 5 author candidates; ruptured-web held for silk/cloth semantic ambiguity. Self-review, not independent or user acceptance.

ruptured-web.svg.reason: The broad opaque folds and scalloped hem read as torn cloth at 160x112 and 80x56; missing strand structure fails to distinguish spider silk from the ritual cloth.

split-slime-membrane.svg.note: Empty blue-green rim and parted flaps read at compact size; faceted planes also suggest folded fabric. Minimum foreground inset 27px versus requested 28px, without clipping.

ritual-cinder-sweep.svg.note: Charred cloth/fold and ember read; ritual cause is a proposed interpretation, not an independently legible semantic cue or established lore.

explosive-scorch.svg.note: Crater and seams remain distinct at 80x56; small heat seams soften at 64x45. Source illustration, not an active explosion cue.
